research_metadata.coverage_notes: Higher education infrastructure in Mugu district is extremely limited. Rara Multiple Campus is the primary recognized higher education institution in the district, affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Other institutions primarily operate as secondary +2 schools without independent higher education degree programs.

identity.name: Rara Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Rara Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in Mugu district, Karnali Province, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Rara Multiple Campus is the leading higher education provider in the remote Mugu district of Karnali Province, Nepal. Established to provide accessible higher education to the local community, it offers programs mainly in humanities and education streams under Tribhuvan University affiliation.
